title: FLA binary import drops document/view state the model carries: ruler guides skipped in CPicPage tail, grid settings + ruler units never read back, layer heightMultiplier discarded
description: Round-trip asymmetry: the real-FLA WRITER emits several model fields that the binary IMPORTER never reads back, so save-real-fla -> reopen loses them (and importing a genuine Flash 8 FLA loses the same authored state). All verified by code reading: (1) RULER GUIDES — docs/21 sec 10.1: the CPicPage tail carries u32 guideCount + {u32 direction; u32 valueTwips}[]; the reader explicitly SKIPS them (flash8-binary.ts readCPicPage:1266-1268 'const cnt = r.u32(); if (cnt>0 && cnt<10000) r.skip(cnt*8)'). The model has doc.properties.guides (model/types.ts:76-90, Guide{orientation,position}, task 0084) and the ZIP-native path round-trips them (roundtrip.test.ts 'grid and guides'), but binary import always yields guides=[]. NOTE: the WRITE side of guides is in-flight under task 1386(f) — this task is the READ side; coordinate so the round-trip closes. (2) GRID + RULER UNITS — the sec 8.4 stage block carries rulerUnitType, gridVisible, gridSpacingX*20 and grid color (written from the model by contents-write.ts writeStageBlock:329-359), but parseFla8Contents (flash8-binary.ts:3579-4167) extracts only width/height/fps/background; Fla8ContentsInfo has no grid/ruler fields and buildFla8Document (flash8-import.ts:2249-2254) builds createDocumentProperties without them -> defaults. (3) LAYER heightMultiplier — writer emits it from layer.height (timeline-write.ts:183) but the reader skips it inside r.skip(7) (flash8-binary.ts readCPicLayer:1315), and convertLayer never sets layer height; also layer isSelected is skipped (fine) yet the writer synthesizes it from locked/visible (timeline-write.ts:176) — document or drop that heuristic. Fix: extend Fla8ContentsInfo + parseFla8Contents to decode rulerUnitType/gridVisible/gridSpacing/gridColor from the stage block (anchor-relative, same 03 B4 anchor already used), read the CPicPage guide array into per-scene guides and merge into doc.properties.guides (Flash stores guides per timeline; model is doc-level — union them, document the choice), and read heightMultiplier into layer.height. Acceptance: saveRealFla -> tryLoadRealFla round-trip test asserting gridWidth/gridColor/rulerUnits/guides (once 1386 lands the guide write) and layer height survive; grid/ruler decode additionally sanity-checked against fixtures/Magnet.fla (stage block present in every genuine Contents).
